Metadata.title: BAHITH | باحث
Metadata.description: An Arabic-first academic research platform: from research question to export, with every claim tied to evidence.

Home.name: BAHITH
Home.tagline: Your methodical assistant for academic research, from research question to export.
Home.principle: Every claim is linked to verifiable evidence (source, page and passage), or explicitly labelled as an inference, a hypothesis or unsupported.
Home.status: A pre-release version: features are tested, but the platform has not been launched yet.
Home.workflowTitle: From a question to traceable evidence
Home.privacyDescription: Accounts and permissions separate project data and control access.
Home.reviewDescription: Claim candidates and quotation matches need your review. Finding a quotation does not establish a claim’s truth.
Home.traceDescription: File versions, passage locations and available page numbers are preserved so you can review quotations in context.

Project.libraryDescription: Upload your sources so SANAD extracts their text with their real page numbers. Scanned pages are read with OCR locally and are never sent to an outside service.
Project.uploadHint: PDF, DOCX, TXT or an image (PNG/JPEG/TIFF), up to 50 MB. The type is detected from the content, not the extension.

Project.uploadTooLarge: The file is larger than 50 MB.
Project.uploadUnsupported: Unsupported file type. Supported: PDF, DOCX, TXT, PNG, JPEG, TIFF.
Project.storageUnavailable: File storage is unavailable right now. The file was not saved.
Project.uploadFailed: The upload failed. Please try again.
Project.readOnly: You can view the library. Uploading is available to owners and editors.
Project.ocrUsed: Read with OCR — needs human review
Project.pageFailures: {count, plural, one {# page could not be read} other {# pages could not be read}}
Project.evidenceDescription: Search the text of this project's sources only. Results are verbatim passages with their stored page numbers; they are not a judgement on whether any claim is true.
Project.searchFailed: The search failed. Please try again.
Project.modeLexical: Text search only (semantic search is off: no embedding model is configured).
Project.noEvidence: I found no evidence in this project's sources.
Project.noPage: No page number (the source has no pages)
Project.openAtPage: Open the source at this page

Draft.exportHint: Citations and the reference list are built automatically in the project's citation style.

warning.FOOTNOTES_AS_CHAPTER_NOTES: In the PDF, footnotes appear at the end of each chapter, not at the page foot.
warning.TOC_NEEDS_FIELD_UPDATE: Word updates the table of contents page numbers when the file is opened.

warning.PDF_BOOKMARKS_OMITTED: PDF bookmarks were omitted for Arabic headings.

review.title: Review
review.hint: Select text in the draft, then add a comment or suggest a change.
review.selectionInvalid: Select text within a single paragraph, without citations or footnotes.
review.accepted: Suggestion applied and saved as version {version}.

error.stale: This suggestion was not applied: the text it refers to has changed or now appears more than once near its place. Edit the draft by hand, or reject the suggestion.
error.invalidAnchor: The selected text does not match the saved draft. Wait for the draft to save, then select the text again.
error.conflict: The draft was changed elsewhere. Reopen it before accepting this suggestion.
error.failed: The action could not be completed. Please try again.

References.title: References and verification
References.description: Every source is checked against Crossref and OpenAlex. Only a verified source counts as a confirmed reference; a mismatch or a missing record is a warning sign of a mistaken or fabricated reference.
References.alreadyAdded: This reference is already in the project.
References.imported: {added, plural, =0 {No new references} one {# reference imported} other {# references imported}}; {duplicates} already present; {skipped} without a title. Imported references are unverified until checked.
References.resultMismatch: The registry record does not match this reference.
References.resultNotFound: No matching record was found. Check the reference for errors.
References.errorNotConfigured: Registry lookups are not configured (SCHOLARLY_CONTACT_EMAIL is missing).
References.errorUnavailable: The registries could not be reached. Nothing was changed; try again later.
References.errorDoiMalformed: This is not a valid DOI.
References.errorDoiNotFound: No record was found for this DOI.
References.errorNeedsDoiOrTitle: A DOI or a title is needed to verify.
References.errorImportUnreadable: The file could not be read as BibTeX or RIS.
References.errorImportMissing: Choose a .bib or .ris file (up to 2 MB).
References.errorImportNotUtf8: The file must be UTF-8 text.

Assistant.title: Research assistant
Assistant.description: Answers only from this project’s sources. Every sentence shows the passage and page it rests on, or is marked as inference or unsupported. When the sources do not answer, it says so.
Assistant.consentTitle: Consent needed before any text leaves the platform
Assistant.consentBody: To answer, the passages retrieved for your question (only from this project) and the question itself are sent to the AI model configured for this platform: {model}. Nothing is sent until you agree, and you can withdraw consent at any time.
Assistant.grantConsent: I agree to send passages to this model
Assistant.consentGiven: Consent given. Passages of this project may be sent to {model}.
Assistant.consentReadOnly: Only an owner or editor can give consent for this project.
Assistant.questionPlaceholder: e.g. What did the study find about…
Assistant.noEvidence: I found no evidence for this in the project’s sources.
Assistant.abstained: The sources retrieved for this question do not answer it, so no answer is given.
Assistant.answeredBy: Answered by {model}; quotes checked verbatim against the stored passages.
Assistant.dropped: {count, plural, one {# citation from the model could not be verified and was removed.} other {# citations from the model could not be verified and were removed.}}
Assistant.errorNotConfigured: No AI model is configured for this platform (AI_CHAT_MODEL). Ask the administrator.
Assistant.errorKeyMissing: The AI provider’s key is not configured. Ask the administrator.
Assistant.errorQuotaNotConfigured: No AI usage allowance is set for this workspace’s plan yet.
Assistant.errorQuotaExceeded: This month’s AI request allowance is used up.
Assistant.errorTimeout: The model took too long to answer. Try again.
Assistant.errorProvider: The AI provider could not answer. Nothing was saved; try again later.
Assistant.errorProviderQuota: The AI provider account has no remaining credit or hit its limit. Nothing was saved; ask the administrator.

ClaimCheck.title: Check a claim
ClaimCheck.description: Write a claim; the model judges each retrieved passage as supporting, contradicting or insufficient, with a verbatim quote. Conflict and evidence strength are computed by code. This is an automated judgement that needs your review.
ClaimCheck.conflict: Conflict: some sources support the claim and others contradict it.
ClaimCheck.needsReview: Automated judgement by {model} — review it before relying on it.
ClaimCheck.noPassages: No passages were retrieved for this claim from the project’s sources.
